events-db.rationale: Authoritative event/evidence history and development approvals, snapshots and aggregate accounting; resolved through api-core/storage and routed database pools.

budget.rationale: Observed 0 bytes on 2026-09-08. A live SQLite WAL must not be pruned independently.

events-db-wal.rationale: Live SQLite write-ahead log; preserve with its database.

events-db-shm.rationale: Live SQLite shared-memory sidecar; preserve with its database.

service.name: swarm-manager
service.description: Central command center for managing scenario ecosystem with backlog-driven execution control and lifecycle orchestration

ollama.description: Local embedding model (nomic-embed-text) for AI search

qdrant.description: Vector store for AI search over backlog items and goals

agent-manager.degraded_behavior: Without agent-manager, swarm-manager refuses to dispatch new agent runs while existing records remain viewable.

plan-manager.description: Canonical plan authoring, rendering, and execution-plan validation
plan-manager.degraded_behavior: Without plan-manager, swarm-manager preserves existing plans but disables plan creation and reconciliation.

scenario-authenticator.description: Verified human identity and scoped operator authority for protected Swarm decisions.
scenario-authenticator.degraded_behavior: Without scenario-authenticator, Swarm Manager keeps read surfaces available but refuses human-authorized development decisions.

knowledge-observatory.degraded_behavior: Without knowledge-observatory, durable problem observations remain local and are not synchronized.

visited-tracker.degraded_behavior: Without visited-tracker, navigation continues without cross-session visited-state cleanup.

scenario-completeness-scoring.degraded_behavior: Without scenario-completeness-scoring, swarm-manager omits completeness scoring while retaining core work management.

test-genie.description: Validation runs, baseline evidence, and completion gates
test-genie.degraded_behavior: Without test-genie, swarm-manager can edit and inspect work but cannot execute server-owned validation runs.

prompt-manager.description: Skill prompt templates for backlog research and processing
prompt-manager.degraded_behavior: Without prompt-manager, swarm-manager keeps direct work flows available but loses skill discovery and reusable prompt guidance.

git-control-tower.description: Required admission, regression evidence, and review provider for plan execution and work review
git-control-tower.degraded_behavior: Without git-control-tower, plan execution and review transitions remain parked until regression and readiness evidence can be obtained.

audio-tools.description: STT (mic input in MessageComposer + QuickCapture) and TTS (assistant message playback in Session Details) flow through audio-tools via the audio-integration UI module and the discovery Connect handler. swarm-manager contains zero audio synthesis/transcription code.
audio-tools.degraded_behavior: If audio-tools is unreachable, the discovery handler returns available:false; the UI hides the mic button and renders an unavailable banner in the Audio settings tab. The API still boots.
